title: Item mail waits for the worker already being launched.
verification: Candidate SQLite, PostgreSQL and CLI regression tests cover queueing, claim-arrival races, launch completion without another hook, expiry, cancellation and unchanged unstaffed refusal. Live production proof is pending the release-bound case.
when: A direct item message is sent before its staffed worker claims
need: A direct item send and preview count its in-flight steering launch as one queued recipient before a holder exists. The message read names its stored launch address and pending or settled state. Without an eligible launch or holder, zero_recipients remains a refusal and names any launch found. Cancel obsolete mail before resending after restaffing.
